comparison_identity.aggregation: Equal-weight form/force strata, equal domain/reference cells within each stratum; maximum tokenizer mean is the least-favourable headline. No rounding.
comparison_identity.comparator: Ainglish minus complete careful English in current tokenizer units; negative is fewer tokens, positive is a premium
comparison_identity.population: Prospectively authored complete procedural mappings: 8 declared domains, 4 new matter references per domain, each in consider-now and postpone. Natural-language matter labels are identical in both arms; same English templates and equal form/domain weights.
comparison_identity.unit_span: one complete meaning-matched utterance pair including all shared contextual text

aggregation.rule: Equal-weight form/force strata, equal domain/reference cells within each stratum; maximum tokenizer mean is the least-favourable headline. No rounding.

estimand_contract.contrast: Ainglish minus complete careful English in current tokenizer units; negative is fewer tokens, positive is a premium
estimand_contract.population: Prospectively authored complete procedural mappings: 8 declared domains, 4 new matter references per domain, each in consider-now and postpone. Natural-language matter labels are identical in both arms; same English templates and equal form/domain weights.
estimand_contract.unit_span: one complete meaning-matched utterance pair including all shared contextual text

method: Preserve the source's complete careful-English templates, tokenizer roster, comparison identity, estimand, member-span interval, and ordered equal-weight form strata. Count Ainglish minus English for each complete pair; take the equal pair mean per tokenizer and report the maximum tokenizer mean without rounding.
scope: Present token cost on this authored replication population only; not comprehension, human naturalness, bare-table performance, adoption, or future-trained efficiency.
selection: Full 64-pair fresh authored census: the source's eight declared domains, four wholly new matter references per domain, and both forms per reference. The fixed matter list and manifest commitment were frozen before tokenizer import.
